_comment: Store listing screenshots for Partner Center, in listing order. Each caption is the image's `description` (Store limit: 200 characters). The Store file name is prefixed with a content hash by update_listing.py, so re-uploading changed pixels under the same name cannot silently no-op.

captions.en-us: Your projects, on your server. Boards, issues, Gantt and time tracking, hosted by you.
captions.de-de: Deine Projekte, auf deinem Server. Boards, Tickets, Gantt und Zeiterfassung, selbst gehostet.

captions.en-us: One board for the whole sprint. Scrum or Kanban. A column warns you when its WIP limit is full.
captions.de-de: Ein Board für den ganzen Sprint. Scrum oder Kanban. Eine Spalte meldet sich, wenn ihr WIP-Limit voll ist.

captions.en-us: Find the issue you need. Filter by state, person or priority. Hold one to edit several.
captions.de-de: Das richtige Ticket schnell gefunden. Nach Status, Person oder Priorität filtern. Lange drücken, um mehrere zu bearbeiten.

captions.en-us: Which task holds up the rest? The Gantt chart draws dependencies and marks the critical path.
captions.de-de: Welche Aufgabe bremst den Rest? Das Gantt-Diagramm zeigt Abhängigkeiten und den kritischen Pfad.

captions.en-us: Will the team finish the sprint? Burndown, velocity and a count of issues per state.
captions.de-de: Schafft das Team den Sprint? Burndown, Velocity und Tickets je Status.

captions.en-us: Sort it out on the issue. Reply in threads, react, or record a voice note.
captions.de-de: Fragen klären, direkt am Ticket. Antworten im Thread, Reaktionen und Sprachnotizen.

notesForCertification: Screenshot and description update after the 2026-08-17 report. Every listing image is the Windows desktop build of Hinata in a standard Windows 11 window (title bar with minimize, maximize and close); no other platform's UI, devices, artwork or symbols appear in the images or in the description.
